name: echoloc_dataset (MP3D collections)
description: Matterport3D buildings rendered as an F3Loc-compatible floorplan localization dataset: one scene id per STOREY ('<scene>_f<k>'), two 4-view collections (mp3d_f forward, mp3d_g general motion), wall-only per-storey maps, ray-cast depth GT, desdf, and co-located 6-mic ring + binaural RIRs.

mp3d_f.motion: forward: step U(0.15,0.40) m along heading, yaw drift N(0,4deg) clipped +-10deg

mp3d_g.motion: 40% forward (yaw U(-20,20)deg, step U(0.10,0.40) m); 35% in-place rotation (monotonic U(10,35)deg/step, translation N(0,0.02) m); 25% mixed (step U(0,0.30) m within +-60deg of heading, yaw U(-35,35)deg)

excluded_scenes.note: buildings without SoundSpaces graph metadata or without a usable storey mask are absent; storeys with < 4 graph nodes or < 8 m2 sealed interior are skipped

pose.format: poses.txt: one line per frame 'x y yaw', ascending in rgb filename order
pose.type: global SE(2) pose in the floorplan frame (not relative)
pose.rotation: yaw only (scalar, radians, [-pi, pi]), CCW from +x; roll = pitch = 0; no quaternion/matrix stored
pose.map_pixel: x_map = x/0.01 + W/2 (col), y_map = y/0.01 + H/2 (row); occ[row, col]; display with origin='lower'
pose.habitat_to_world: x = habitat_x - world_cx_habitat; y = -habitat_z - world_cy_habitat_neg_z; habitat theta (about +y, forward = -z) = yaw - pi/2   (per-scene offsets in maps/<scene>/scene_meta.json)
pose.height: camera/array 1.25 m above the navmesh floor (floor_y_habitat in scene_meta.json); per-frame habitat xyz in chunks.json['chunks'][i]['frames'][v]['hab']

map.source: 0.05 m wall mask (height-band vote, furniture/lintels removed, navmesh envelope sealed, rooms = flood fill from SoundSpaces graph nodes) upsampled x5 nearest

depth.angles: center_angs = flip(arctan2(u - u.mean(), ray_n * F_W)) + yaw
depth.value: camera-forward z-depth = ray range * cos(center_ang), metres
depth.ray_cast: echoloc_simulator/raycast.py (exact Amanatides-Woo DDA); NOT F3Loc utils.ray_cast, which skips wall-corner pixels on left/down steps and leaked 0.3-0.4% of rays

dirs.depth_radial_floorplan: floor-plan proxy (walls only; the geometry map.png encodes)

depth_maps.name: {chunk:05d}-{view}.png (same as rgb/)
depth_maps.value: radial (Euclidean along the pixel ray), NOT camera-forward z: radial = z * sqrt(1 + ((u+0.5-cx)/fx)^2 + ((v+0.5-cy)/fy)^2)
depth_maps.camera: same K / pose / height as rgb/

desdf.layout: {'l': int, 't': int, 'desdf': (H, W, 36)}; x_map = x_desdf*10 + l

scan_voids.note: Replica scans have unscanned space (frl_apartment_*: no ceiling; apartment_1/2: voids behind doorways). Every pose is kept; chunks.json['chunks'][i]['frames'][v]['scan_nohit_lower'] = fraction of no-hit pixels below image row 120 when the scan is rendered at that frame (0 = fully covered). Filter downstream.

constraints: clearance >= 0.25 m from nearest wall pixel
snap_point within 3 cm horizontally and 0.3 m vertically of the scene floor
segment between consecutive frames does not cross a wall
pose_sampling.chunks_per_scene: auto: 0.6 per m2 of sealed free area, clipped to [40, 160] (sample_poses.py --n-chunks 0)

acoustics.binaural: rir_binaural*.npy (2, n) float32 = RLR built-in HRTF binaural render at the same pose, head yaw = camera yaw + rel, channels [left, right], same source/acoustics as the ring
acoustics.pose_index: row of the collection's poses.txt (reference frames only, view 3)

conditions.raw_scan_open: Replica scan mesh as shipped (open boundaries, scan holes)

acoustics.sample_rate_note: spec 8000; 48 kHz to match the earlier replica_0422/house_traj renders

headings.files: rel000 -> rir.npy / rir_binaural.npy; binaural others -> rir_binaural_rel{deg:03d}.npy
headings.note: yaw_h = camera yaw + rel (CCW); the mono ring has no directivity so only rel 0 is rendered

acoustics.source: co-located with the array centre, 1.25 m above the navmesh floor
acoustics.diffraction_note: spec 4.3 lists diffraction=false; enabled deliberately because the dataset targets NLOS (cost-neutral in RLR)
acoustics.channel_render: RLR Mono x 6: receiver moved to each mic position, source fixed
acoustics.rir_shape: (6, n) float32 (n varies; RLR trims when energy is gone, ~0.4 s at ray depth 50)
acoustics.usable_window: rir[:, peak+guard : peak+guard+usable] (same 2 ms / 128 ms as the spec at 8 kHz)

rir_version_history.settings: 8 kHz, 4096 rays, depth 6, diffraction OFF, ring 6ch only, 1 heading, (6, 2049)
rir_version_history.status: spec 4.3 verbatim; discarded and DELETED (NLOS needs diffraction)
aborted, deleted (sample rate/headings changed to match earlier renders)

rir_version_history.settings: 48 kHz, 20000 rays, depth 200, ring and binaural at 4 headings
rir_version_history.status: aborted, deleted (~36 h / ~300 GB for no information gain)

rir_version_history.settings: 48 kHz, 20000 rays, depth 50, diffraction on (order 10), ring 6ch rel 0 + binaural 2ch rel 0/90/180/270

deviations_from_spec: ray cast: exact DDA (echoloc_simulator/raycast.py) instead of F3Loc utils.ray_cast (corner-pixel leak)
RIR rendered for reference frames only (render_rir.py --all-views for every frame)
camera height 1.25 m chosen to co-locate with the acoustic source
RIR rendered WITH edge diffraction (spec acoustics block says false) — NLOS

RIR indirect rays 20000 and ray depth 50 instead of 4096 / 6: at 4096 rays identical re-renders correlate only ~0.74, and depth 6 drops all reflections beyond ~36 ms; depth 50 matches depth 200 (RLR default) in energy terms at 1/3 the cost
RIR sample rate 48 kHz instead of 8 kHz; binaural at 4 relative headings (0/90/180/270) per pose as in the earlier Replica/MP3D renders (ring at rel 0 only: mono mics have no directivity)

storeys.scene_id: <mp3d scene>_f<k>, k = 0 lowest storey (SoundSpaces graph nodes clustered by height, gap > 1 m)
storeys.frame: all storeys of a building share one map frame (same origin/size); z band per storey in maps/<id>/scene_meta.json
